mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are looking at clear skies near Verona Area High School. Under the light of the New Moon, temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 35 degrees, and you will be happy to hear there is no rain in the forecast for tonight.

The city has announced pavement repairs for Tuesday, November 10 and Wednesday, November 11. Crews will be milling and patching streets including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street, with paving to follow the next day. Please keep an eye out for no parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

We have a busy week ahead! You can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking to tomorrow, yoga is happening at Insight Wellness. On Wednesday, you have plenty of options including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In a report regarding an incident on October 25, the Verona Police Department arrested a 40-year-old local man for an O W I after he was discovered stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
